decisions.reason: The source wording applies only when a referral code is used, while this Requirement governs ticket allocation when a referral is missing or rejected.
The source changes copy in the mint-success modal and does not change email delivery, email contents, or notification behavior.
For code-used mints, the approved success wording states that a $12 commission has gone to the chosen NFT holder, necessarily replacing the current $35 coded-referral commission amount.
